designationHistory.indexText: Franz Lake National Wildlife Refuge is the largest and most intact wapato and rush marsh remaining on the lower Columbia River and was established in 1990 to preserve biodiversity.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
